lanes.summary: I reviewed the changes and verified that all claims in the receipt regarding REX-07 Ask 2 and the PMAT-4252/PMAT-4362 criteria are properly fulfilled. `weights_identity` correctly hashes the file in 1MB chunks and tracks file size and mtime_ns, `weights_still` validates these before /health is answered, and `parse_gx10` accurately carries `model` and `model_sha256` into the receipt's provenance. Comprehensive tests were added to `test_apr_dogfood_lane_4252_parse.py` to cover these behaviors. I found no evidence refuting the receipt claims, and no regression or weakening of existing constraints. Note: `paiml-lane-witness` file was not found in the workspace git dir, so a missing value is provided.

findings.claim: weights_identity(path, prev) hashes the model file in 1 MiB chunks... and records {model, size, mtime_ns, model_sha256}
weights_still(ident) runs when /health answers... withdraws the hash if size or mtime_ns moved
parse_gx10 carries model and model_sha256 from state.json into the receipt's provenance
Measured: the three lane test files are GREEN... The new rows cover: from state, absent -> null, the sha equals hashlib's...

lanes.summary: Review of diff for PMAT-4252 and PMAT-4362 (REX-07 Ask 2). The diff implements model weight sha256 hashing prior to server startup, stat-based cache reuse, invalidation/withdrawal upon file changes prior to /health, and carries model and model_sha256 in gx10 receipt provenance. All receipt claims are backed by the diff and tests assert the required behavior without weakening gates or expanding scope beyond the tickets.

findings.claim: weights_identity hashes the model file in 1 MiB chunks before apr serve starts and records model, size, mtime_ns, model_sha256, reusing previous hash on stat match
weights_still withdraws the hash (null + why) if the model file size or mtime_ns changed before /health answers
start_server invokes weights_identity before subprocess launch and weights_still upon /health success
parse_gx10 populates model and model_sha256 into receipt provenance from watcher state, defaulting to None if absent
test_apr_dogfood_lane_4252_parse.py exercises parse_gx10 extraction, null fallback, stat caching, withdrawal on change, re-hashing on update, and missing file error handling
PMAT-4252 and PMAT-4362 tasks and criteria for REX-07 Ask 2 are registered in roadmap entries and aggregated in roadmap.yaml
